guards.gold_holdout: whole homology clusters, seed 0, 20% of holin clusters; never trained on
guards.independent_evidence: model score >= P95 threshold AND annotated endolysin/spanin within 3 genes; context is never a model feature
guards.diversity_cap: <= 3 accepted per source genome, <= 150 per iteration
guards.counter_metrics: stop unless gold AP improves by > 0.002; stop if LOFO recall falls or hard-case median rises by > 0.05
guards.ambiguous_handling: high score without context evidence is excluded, never relabelled negative
